notes: 00:09 Tiny floating island at night, a white bunny-ish creature with its back to me, trees. Day 1 with a 30 sec timer, 10 coins, Lv1. A yellow box highlights grass on the left and says 'Tap an empty tile'. I'll tap inside the box.
00:17 Oh, it became day 2 and sunny; the bunny turned around, cute. A build menu: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. I have exactly 10 coins. Building a farm.
00:34 Farm built in ~4s, coins now 0, got 5 XP. Night again already (days are 30 sec). Bottom shows Sow / Water / Harvest, 5 sec each. Hint says tap the farm to sow. Tapping the farm plot.
00:51 Seeds planted (little dots in the soil). Day 3. Now 'Tap again to water -- three times in all'. The hint bubble is covering the bunny's face, a little annoying. Tapping farm to water.
01:08 First watering done, sprouts showing. Water button says '10s left' - maybe a cooldown before the next watering? Now hint says 'Tap a Momo' - so the bunny is called a Momo. Tapping it.

01:16 Tapped Momo: panel says 'Momo - Free time' with an Assign button. Hint: 'Its tiles light up. The pencil edits them'. I don't really see tiles lighting up, just a ring under Momo. Not sure what 'its tiles' means. Tapping the pencil.

01:32 Hmm, Momo wanders around and the pencil moved with it, so my taps kept missing; now the panel closed and the tutorial hint is gone. A bit frustrating chasing a moving target. Let me go back to the farm and water it again (it said three times).

01:51 Second watering done, plants are leafy now - nice visible growth. Water shows '9s left', so there's a wait between waterings. While waiting, let me try the Momo again and press Assign this time - maybe it can work the farm for me.

02:01 Clearer hint now: 'The pencil edits which tiles this Momo looks after: tap or drag over tiles'. So I paint tiles for the Momo to tend. I want it to look after the farm. Tapping Got it, then the pencil.
02:17 Got into edit mode: a checkmark and '0 / 4 tiles'. So the Momo can look after up to 4 tiles. The island seems to be 4 tiles total. Tapping the farm tile to add it.

02:27 Farm tile highlighted with a '1' and the Momo walked straight over to it. Panel now: 'Working at Farm, Farm skill 0, 0 jobs, Stays here, Route: Nearest first'. That's satisfying - I've got a worker. Confirming with the checkmark.
02:36 Confirmed. Momo is sitting in the farm with a progress ring - it seems to be doing the watering itself. While it works, I'm curious about the Mailbox button top right.
02:46 Mailbox: 'No letters yet'. But look - red tomatoes in the farm now! Momo has 1 job done and a '...' speech bubble. Closing mail, peeking at Research.

02:57 Research is a big tech tree: tabs Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games, Ca(?). First node 'Field expansion' costs 3 flasks + $20, 1 min. I have no flasks and no money, and don't know where flasks come from - probably that Research lab at Lv2. Lots ahead! Closing it, going to watch the harvest.

03:08 Momo harvested - farm is empty again, 2 jobs, XP jumped to 29/100. But coins still 0, and there's some cut-off text '1 c...' at the right screen edge under the XP bar that I can't read. Where did the tomatoes go? Do I need to sell them? Checking Status.

03:20 Coins went 0 -> 5, so the harvest did sell (just with a delay). Status screen: the island is 'Momonium - A small island, a big tomorrow'. Village -> City goal: Land 4/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 0/3, Value produced $5/$1.5K. Now I have a long-term goal! Skill bars for Farm/Mine/Lumber/Research/Smelting. Tapping Got it, then Store tab.

03:37 Store tab: Crops 0/20, Made 1 - a storage, and the one crop got sold automatically I guess. Momo is on its 4th job, working steadily on its own. Closing this and checking the Shop button bottom left.

03:51 Shop has one thing: Hire Momo $25. I only have $5. Each harvest seems to give ~$5, so that's a while. Better plan: when I hit $10, build a second farm on another empty tile. Closing shop and tapping an empty tile to see the build menu.

04:04 Build menu again (Farm $10 in red, can't afford). Ooh - Momo has an envelope speech bubble and the Mailbox has a red dot. A letter from the Momo! First, peeking at 'Special 0/1' in the build menu.
04:15 Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6). One of each, 0/1 slots. Nice long-term carrots. Got it, then reading the letter.
04:27 A letter from Momo: 'What if we widened the field?' - cute, the worker is suggesting the Field expansion research. Opening it.

04:37 Lovely letter, styled like a real airmail envelope with a flower stamp. Momo proposes Field expansion. 'Let's research it' button. I doubt I can afford it ($20 + 3 flasks), but let's press it and see.

04:50 Button now says 'On the research list'. OK. Coins have been stuck at $5 for a few days though, while tomatoes keep growing. Wondering how money comes in. Closing mail and waiting to watch a full cycle.

05:14 Another harvest: XP 54/100, but coins STILL $5. That clipped '1 c...' popup appears again at the far right edge - maybe '+1 crop'? It's cut off so I can't read it. Going to the Status > Money tab to understand income.

05:28 Money tab: now $10! Income seems to land when the day rolls over ('Yesterday +$5'), with a 7-day bar chart. Also an intriguing 'Island worth $61 - Sell...' button - not touching that! With $10 I'll build a second farm on the empty tile in front.
05:48 Second farm going up on the front tile, $0 again. Once it's built I'll add it to Momo's tiles with the pencil so it farms both.
06:02 Two farms side by side now, looks great. Sowing the new one myself by tapping it.
06:13 Sowing the new farm. Now selecting Momo to add the new farm tile to its route.
06:24 Momo is selected, Farm skill went up to 1 after 11 jobs - it's learning! Pencil, then tap the new farm.
06:37 2/4 tiles, numbered 1 and 2 - the numbers look like a route order. Confirming. Then I'll try 'Route: Nearest first' to see what it does.

06:50 Route switched to 'Row by row' and the tile numbers swapped (front farm is now 1). It says 'Comparing: a few days are needed on each side' - neat, it'll tell me which route is better. Another letter arrived (red dot + envelope over Momo). XP 83/100, close to level 2. Reading the mail.

07:09 Second letter: 'Maybe we could water less often' - straw mulch idea, proposes Watering efficiency. Charming that the ideas come from the worker. Accepting it. (Also noticed the 1/2 tile numbers flipped back again - a little confusing which is which.)

07:23 Research panel now answers my flask question: the button says 'Build a research lab'. That opens at Lv2 and I'm at 86/100 XP. Hmm, only Field expansion has a yellow dot; the Watering efficiency I just accepted still looks locked. Closing and waiting for level 2.

07:51 Panel now reports 'Since the change: 1.4 -> 3 jobs a day' - satisfying, the route change (or the second farm?) doubled output. Not sure which one deserves credit. Still $5 though, money feels slow. XP 88/100. Waiting for level 2.
08:21 Both farms are loaded with ripe tomatoes, Momo is harvesting one. Coins have sat at $5 for 3+ days though, which confuses me. I'll help by harvesting the front farm myself.
08:34 Level 2! (10/180) - it just quietly ticked over, I almost missed it; no celebration. Research lab and Lumberyard should be open now. Tapping the empty right-hand tile to see their prices.

08:46 Unlocked prices: Research lab $45, Lumberyard $80. I have $5 - a long way off at this pace. The clipped '2 c...' popup at the right edge again. Checking the Store tab to see if crops are piling up unsold.
08:59 Coins jumped to $15 at the new day - two crops yesterday, $5 each, paid at dawn. Made 5 crops total. Now it clicks: crops sell overnight. Quick peek at the 'Life' tab before time runs out.

09:10 Life tab: Happiness 0/100 ('No parks, pubs or halls yet'), Homes 0/0, '1 sleeps outdoors' in red - aww, my poor Momo has no house! But I never saw a house in the build menu. Momo work time x1. That makes me want to give it a home. Saving up $45 for the research lab next.

09:22 Stats tab is a wall of numbers: +$2.1/-$1.4 per day, crops 0.4 made/used/sold per day, farm busy 55%/32%, Momo busy 83%, Power 0 kW. Too spreadsheet-y for me right now, but nice for later. Main takeaway: income is ~$2/day and the lab is $45 - slow. Next step would be hiring a second Momo ($25) to work the second farm.
00:08 A tiny island floating in the sea with a white bunny thing and a heart bubble. It says Day 2 already, and 'Tap an empty tile' with a yellow box highlighted. I'll tap the grass inside the box.
00:21 Spent my only 10 coins on a Farm. Whoa, it turned night already - a day is only 30 seconds? The bunny is hammering the farm, 4 sec. Waiting to see it finish.
00:47 Sowed seeds, got 1 XP. Now 'tap again to water -- three times in all'. Feels like a cozy farming loop. Tapping the farm to water.
00:55 Oops - the bunny (Momo) was standing in the middle of the farm, so my tap picked Momo instead: 'Momo, Free time, Assign'. Night again. I'll tap the farm's edge away from Momo.
01:11 Sprouts! Water says '11s left' - maybe a cooldown before the next watering. Now it asks me to 'Tap a Momo'. Tapping the bunny.
01:19 Missed - Momo walked away and I tapped water, which showed an expansion plot for $35 (not enough money). So the island can grow! Trying to tap Momo again where it is now.
01:35 Got Momo selected. Crops grew big. Hint: 'Its tiles light up. The pencil edits them' - not sure which tiles; I don't see anything lit. Pencil icon is highlighted, so I'll tap it.
01:43 Hmm, tapping the pencil just took me back to 'Tap a Momo'. Did nothing visible. A bit confusing. Momo is standing still now, tapping it.

02:09 Frustrating: Momo keeps wandering, so by the time I tap the pencil it has moved and I hit the sea (expansion $35 popup again). The tutorial loops back to 'Tap a Momo'. But tomatoes are ripe! I have 0 coins, so harvesting feels more important. Tapping the farm.

02:36 Finally got the pencil! Harvest gave +$5 and XP jumped to 29. Now: 'Tap tiles or drag across them 0/4'. I guess I'm choosing which tiles Momo works on. Island looks like 4 tiles. Tapping the farm tile.
02:48 Momo is now 'Working at Farm' with a numbered route (1). A big tips box popped up explaining watering cooldown and demolishing. Lots of text at once. Tapping Got it.
03:09 Confirmed. Momo now 'Working at Farm, 1 jobs' - so it should farm on its own now? I have $5, not enough for another farm ($10). Let me peek at the Mailbox - maybe free stuff.
03:33 Mailbox empty. Shop sells one thing: 'Hire Momo $25'. So more bunnies = more workers. Goal forming: save money -> more farms / more Momos. Checking Research.

03:48 Research: a big tech tree - Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 0/3 flasks + $20. I have no flasks - probably from the Research lab that opens at Lv2. Nice long-term goals. Closing, checking Status.

04:04 Status page: my island is 'Momonium', a Village. To become a City: Land 4/9, Momo 1/3, Research 0/3, Value $5/$1.5K. That's a clear big goal. $1.5K feels far when a harvest gives $5. Closing to go make money.

04:47 Momo harvested on its own (XP 33->53) but coins stayed at 5 - where did the crops go? I see a cut-off '1 c...' at the right edge under the XP bar. Also a letter bubble over Momo and a red dot on Mailbox! Opening mail.

05:07 Aww, a letter from Momo proposing to widen the field - cute, Momo has its own ideas. Coins went to 10 (the money arrived a while after harvest). Let me see what 'Let's research it' does - I think I lack the flasks.
05:21 It's now 'On the research list'. OK. With $10 I'll build a second farm so money comes faster. Closing mail and tapping the empty left tile.
05:42 Second farm under construction on the left tile, back to 0 coins. Plan: once built, add it to Momo's route with the pencil so Momo tends both.
06:07 New farm built and I can sow it myself with the Sow button - so I'm a worker too, alongside Momo. Now I want Momo to include this farm in its route. Tapping Momo.
06:37 Route now 1 -> 2, two farms. Momo got 'Farm skill 1', nice little growth. Confirming, then reading the new mail.

07:00 Another Momo letter: water less often (mulch/straw). These letters are charming - they make the upgrade feel like Momo's idea. Adding it to research list. XP 86/100, almost Lv 2 which unlocks the Research lab and Lumberyard.
07:24 Momo walked onto the farm I wanted, so the Momo panel stays. It's hard to tap a farm when Momo stands on it. Trying the other (top) farm.
07:36 Ha, it looks like when Momo is selected, tapping a farm sends Momo there instead of selecting the farm. Not sure if that's what's happening. I'll just let the two farms run and watch the coins.
08:23 Level 2! Quiet level-up though - I almost missed it. But coins are stuck at 5 even after harvests; I don't understand when crops turn into money. Let me see what the Research lab costs now.
08:36 +$5, now $10. Lv2 prices: Research lab $45, Lumberyard $80, Farm $10. Curious about the star 'Special 0/1' - tapping it to see what it is.
08:47 Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6). A Momo Monument, lol. Something to look forward to. Going back to build a 3rd farm with my $10.
09:06 Third farm going up on the right tile. Island is filling up - 3 of 4 tiles. Next I'd want to save $45 for the Research lab so Momo's letter ideas can actually be researched.

09:31 Sowing farm 3 myself, seeds flying in. Three plots of crops at different stages - it looks lovely at night. Feels relaxing, but money is very slow ($5 at a time) and I still don't get when harvests pay out.

00:07 First screen: a small floating grassy island in the ocean, a bunny-like creature with a blue hood seen from behind, trees. HUD says Day 2, 11/30 sec, 10 coins, Lv1 0/100. A hint says 'Tap an empty tile' with a yellow box highlighting a patch of grass. Going to tap inside that box.
00:14 A build menu popped up: Farm 10 dollars (I have 10), Mine opens Lv3, Lumberyard Lv2, Research lab Lv2, Special 0/1. Sky turning dusk already - days are only 30 seconds. Building the farm.
00:20 Coins went to 0. Farm is under construction, 4 sec. It became night with a moon - very pretty day/night cycle. Waiting for it to finish.
00:31 Farm built, got 5 XP, now Day 3. The bunny has a heart bubble - cute. Hint: Tap the farm to sow. Bottom shows Sow / Water / Harvest steps, 5 sec each. Tapping the farm.

00:38 Oops, the bunny walked onto the farm and I tapped HER instead. Her name is Momo, 'Free time', with an Assign button. There's a pencil icon above her (rename?). The hint still says tap the farm to sow. Let me try Assign, maybe that puts her to work on the farm.
00:46 Assign button lit up greenish but nothing obvious changed; Momo still says Free time. Maybe now I pick a building? Tapping the farm at its left edge, away from Momo.

00:53 OK! Momo is now 'Working at Farm', farm skill 0, 0 jobs, 'Stays here', 'Route: Nearest first'. So Assign then tap a building = put her to work. Not super obvious but the hint helped. Hint says the bar fills then it's done. Waiting.

01:05 Day 4. +1 EXP, Momo has done 1 job. But I don't see crops yet and no coins. I don't actually see a bar filling - just a '1' badge. Closing her panel by tapping the sea to see the farm's own state.
01:12 Now I see it: a green ring above the farm is filling - that's 'the bar'. Gorgeous sunset. Waiting for the ring to finish.
01:23 XP 7 now. Tiny sprouts in the farm? Momo has a '...' speech bubble and the hint now says 'Tap a Momo'. Tapping her.
01:30 Tapped Momo: 2 jobs done. New hint: 'Its tiles light up. The pencil edits them.' So the pencil edits which tiles she works? Tapping the pencil.
01:39 Edit mode: '1/4 tiles', tap tiles or drag across them. So Momo can cover up to 4 tiles. But I only have one farm... Trying to tap a grass tile next to the farm to see what happens.

01:48 Now 2/4 tiles - the empty grass tile I tapped turned blue (added to Momo's area). The farm has leafy plants now! A text box explains: plants need time between waterings, any empty tile can build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab, demolish = tap, bin, check, half refunded. A lot of text at once. Tapping Got it.
01:56 Island looks like a 2x2 grid of tiles; farm on top. The left tile is now in Momo's zone. Still 0 coins - I want the harvest to pay out. Confirming with the check mark.
02:03 Tile edit saved, the tutorial bubbles are gone. Now I just want to see the crops get harvested and coins come in. Waiting ~10 seconds.
02:20 Red fruits are hanging in the farm now - ripe! 4 jobs done (sow, water, ...). Next should be harvest. Waiting a bit more for coins.
02:34 Momo seems to be harvesting now (ring filling, red fruit near her ears). Patience... still 0 coins.

02:48 Harvest done: XP jumped 9 -> 29, but coins are still 0. Odd. There was a cut-off '1 c...' text at the right screen edge (clipped). Mailbox got a red dot and Momo shows an envelope bubble. Opening the Mailbox.
02:56 Coins finally 5! (so maybe a separate selling step after harvest). Mailbox has a letter from Momo: 'What if we widened the field?' Aww. Opening it.

03:04 Charming letter from Momo: set rows closer, till to the edges, more plants on the same island. 'Proposal - Field expansion' with a 'Let's research it' button. I love that the upgrade comes as a letter from the character. Tapping Let's research it.
03:12 Button changed to 'On the research list'. Let's look at the Research screen.

03:23 Research tree! Tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games, Ca(t?)... Field expansion costs 0/3 flasks + 20 dollars, 1 min, needs a research lab (which opens at Lv2). Big tree below it (watering, bigger harvests, greenhouse, drip irrigation, millet). What is a flask though? I don't have any. Closing and checking Status.

03:38 Status: island is called Momonium, 'A small island, a big tomorrow.' Farm Lv1 39/100 EXP. Village -> City goal: Land 4/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 0/3, value produced 5 / 1.5K. So there's a long-term goal: more land, more Momos. Got it, then peeking at Store tab.
03:49 Store tab: Crops 0/20, Made 1. So the one crop got sold automatically for 5 dollars I guess. Checking Money tab.

03:58 Money tab: 5 earned, 10 spent, and 'Island worth 49 - Sell...' - selling the whole island? Sounds like a prestige/restart thing, not touching it yet. One harvest cycle took about a minute and a half for only 5 dollars, feels slow. Closing and checking the Shop.

04:10 Shop has just one thing: Hire Momo, 25 dollars. Second crop already ripening - faster this time. Plan: save 10 dollars and build a second farm on the left tile, which I already put in Momo's work area. Then save for a second Momo. Closing shop and letting time pass.

04:32 Second harvest: XP 33 -> 53, and again a clipped '1 c' popup on the very right edge of the screen, I can't read it. Coins still 5 - money seems to arrive later than the harvest. Waiting to see when it lands.
04:49 That '1 c' text is stuck on the right edge under the level bar, cut off. Coins still 5. Checking Status > Store to see if the crop is sitting in storage instead of being sold.
04:59 Got it: crops are sold when a new day starts - now 10 coins on Day 12. Made 2 crops total. Time to build the second farm on the left tile.
05:10 Build menu is up, though I can't clearly see which tile is selected (the menu covers it). Building Farm for 10.
05:19 Second farm is being built on the left tile - right where I wanted. Scaffolding poles, nice touch. Waiting for it, then I'll see if Momo picks it up on her own since it's in her zone.

05:36 Yes! Momo walked over to the new farm on her own and is sowing it, while the first farm grows leafy plants. Two farms going. Lv 61/100 - Lv2 will unlock lumberyard and research lab. There's a 'Farm 1/1 >' label at the bottom - tapping it to see what the arrow does.

05:48 Farm detail panel: a cycle gives 1 crop; 'Cycle by hand 1 min 10s' vs 'Cycle by Momo 1 min 48s' - so I can work farms myself and I'm faster than Momo! Crop choices (hardy crop, millet locked), and refits into Villa/Park/Pub at higher levels. Closing it and trying to work the FIRST farm by hand with the Sow/Water/Harvest buttons.

06:00 Tapped Momo again by accident - she keeps standing on the building I aim for. Farm skill went up to 1, 15 jobs. The farms are numbered 1 and 2 (her route order I think). Got it, then tapping the right corner of farm 1 to avoid her.
06:12 Farm 1 selected: full of ripe tomatoes, Harvest button says '5s left'. The pencil tip popped up again even though I pressed Got it. Waiting 5s then tapping Harvest myself.

06:28 When I tapped Harvest, Momo had already walked back and started harvesting farm 1 herself (Farm 1/1). The button shows a progress bar but I can't tell whether it's me helping or just her. Farm 2 has leafy plants. Waiting for the harvest.
06:44 Harvest done, XP 86/100 - close to Lv2. Momo already re-sowed and is watering. Another letter from Momo (envelope bubble + red dot). Reading it.
06:53 New letter: 'Maybe we could water less often'. She's clearly feeling the watering pain (water x3 per crop). Opening and adding it to research.

07:02 Letter about straw mulch / slow seep watering -> Proposal: Watering efficiency. 5 coins arrived at dawn (Day 16). Adding to research, then I'll try watering farm 1 myself - its Water button says 5s left.
07:13 Farm 2 is full of ripe tomatoes while Momo is busy watering farm 1. Perfect chance to harvest farm 2 by hand. Selecting farm 2 then Harvest.

07:25 Argh. Momo walked onto farm 2 just as I tapped it, so I selected HER, and my second tap landed on her 'Release' button instead of Harvest. Now she's on 'Free time'. Frustrating that she keeps standing on the thing I want to tap. Re-assigning her: Assign, then tap the farm.
07:37 LEVEL 2! (9/180). Momo is back to work but only farm 1 has a badge now - re-assigning reset her zone. Using the pencil to add farm 2 back.
07:48 Farm 2 is back in her zone (2/4 tiles, badges 1 and 2). Confirming. Then let me check what a Research lab costs on an empty tile now that I'm Lv2.
08:00 Lv2 prices: Lumberyard 80, Research lab 45, Farm 10. I have 10 (sold at dawn). The lab is a long way off at 5 coins per crop. Peeking at 'Special 0/1' first.
08:09 Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6) - one of each. A Momo Monument, ha. Long-term carrots. Going back and building a third farm with my 10 coins.
08:25 Third farm going up on the right tile. Harvest sold at dawn so I have 5 left, Lv2 32/180. Once it's built I'll add it to Momo's tiles with the pencil (3/4).
08:38 Farm 3 is built and selected, nobody working it (0/1), Sow button is lit. Sowing it myself this time.
08:45 Seeds flying into farm 3 - I'm sowing it by hand, the bar under Sow is filling. Feels good to contribute. Next I'll water.
08:55 Seeds planted in neat dots in farm 3. Water is lit now. Watering by hand.

09:02 Water droplets falling on farm 3 under my hand while Momo tends farms 1 and 2. Three farms, island is almost full (one grass tile left). With about a minute left: I like the cozy look and the letters, but money is slow - 5 dollars per crop, lab costs 45. Letting it run.
09:22 Farm 3 sprouted! The Water button has three little dots on top - first one filled, so that's the 'water x3' count. Watering again.

09:29 Second watering going on farm 3. Farm 2 is red with ripe tomatoes again, Momo is on farm 1. Nothing sold this dawn, still 5 coins. Final thought: calm and pretty, I understood the loop, but I'd want income to speed up soon to keep me.
